fills.notes: The construction requires a triad of agencies shaping Adam: the Light of the First-born of Heaven, (the First-born of) Earth, and the Five Sons. Restoring “earth; through” yields a smooth correspondential sequence: celestial light (heaven) → natural receptacle (earth) → differentiated powers (the five sons) as mediating forms.

The point is protective power accruing to the rulers from the exalted image in Adam: heavenly beings would “fear” even rulers (i.e., be constrained by the awe/authority carried in the image), so hostile actions could not be executed against them on account of Adam. This matches the substrate’s impersonal mechanics of restraint by higher form, not moral exhortation.

assessment: Most gaps are trivial letter-restorations. The two substantive restorations are constrained by the cosmological sequence (Heaven/Earth/Five Sons) and by the logic of protection as constraint-by-awe: the exalted image in Adam induces fear/restraint even across ranks, preventing harm to the rulers ‘on account of Adam.’
